cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/bigaudit.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, algo
prof = json.load(open('/tmp/bigprof2.json'))
fab = json.load(open('/tmp/bigfab2.json'))
t0=time.time(); plan = algo.compile_plan(prof, fab); print('plan', round(time.time()-t0,2))
t0=time.time(); r = algo.audit(prof, fab, plan); print('audit', round(time.time()-t0,2), r)
print('maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
# corrupt in a way only the Bellman check catches: raise one bound and its witness chain consistently?
plan2 = json.loads(json.dumps(plan))
B = plan2['bounds_as']; A = plan2['age_rounds']; P = plan2['pred']
# find a cell whose predecessor chain is length 1 (direct from an anchor) and bump the whole chain
for p in range(len(B)):
    for i in range(len(B[p])):
        if isinstance(P[p][i], list) and B[P[p][i][0]//len(B[0])][P[p][i][0]%len(B[0])] == 0:
            B[p][i] += 1; A[p][i] += 0
            print('bumped', p, i); break
    else:
        continue
    break
t0=time.time(); r2 = algo.audit(prof, fab, plan2); print('audit corrupted', round(time.time()-t0,2), r2)
EOF
timeout 900 python3 -B /tmp/bigaudit.py
